Which integral is obtained?

$$
\int \tan{\left(4 x \right)} \sec{\left(4 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "86df9637-597a-5564-98ec-e1285a2b614d" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=4.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \tan{\left(4 x \right)} \sec{\left(4 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{4}\left(\int \tan{\left(u \right)} \sec{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\frac{1}{4}\left(\int \tan{\left(u \right)} \sec{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] [:db/add "86df9637-597a-5564-98ec-e1285a2b614d" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "86df9637-597a-5564-98ec-e1285a2b614d" :question/answer-fields "5547e870-ea5e-5240-a320-2701146b3083" :question/problem "Use the substitution $u=3 x$. Which integral is obtained?

$$
\int 2 \sec^{2}{\left(3 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "5547e870-ea5e-5240-a320-2701146b3083" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=3.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 2 \sec^{2}{\left(3 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{2}{3}\left(\int \sec^{2}{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\frac{2}{3}\left(\int \sec^{2}{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] [:db/add "5547e870-ea5e-5240-a320-2701146b3083" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "5547e870-ea5e-5240-a320-2701146b3083" :question/answer-fields "30b2284d-ab69-57ac-8d3e-1f9f9a820a4f"] [:db/ensure "5547e870-ea5e-5240-a320-2701146b3083" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068916 :knowledge-point/questions "5547e870-ea5e-5240-a320-2701146b3083"] [:db/add "e47027d5-cebb-5a6e-ba2a-199f22a1dfcf" :answer/id #uuid "e47027d5-cebb-5a6e-ba2a-199f22a1dfcf"] [:db/add "e47027d5-cebb-5a6e-ba2a-199f22a1dfcf" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "e47027d5-cebb-5a6e-ba2a-199f22a1dfcf" :answer/value "2"] [:db/ensure "e47027d5-cebb-5a6e-ba2a-199f22a1dfcf" :answer/validate] [:db/add "726fbe57-9e99-5ca8-a32c-2927b6ccd612" :answer-field/id #uuid "726fbe57-9e99-5ca8-a32c-2927b6ccd612"] [:db/add "726fbe57-9e99-5ca8-a32c-2927b6ccd612" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "726fbe57-9e99-5ca8-a32c-2927b6ccd612" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "726fbe57-9e99-5ca8-a32c-2927b6ccd612" :answer-field/choices "e47027d5-cebb-5a6e-ba2a-199f22a1dfcf"] [:db/add "726fbe57-9e99-5ca8-a32c-2927b6ccd612" :answer-field/correct "e47027d5-cebb-5a6e-ba2a-199f22a1dfcf"] [:db/ensure "726fbe57-9e99-5ca8-a32c-2927b6ccd612" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "a12513cf-5b77-57ed-9d9c-cdf66ea9782e" :question/id #uuid "a12513cf-5b77-57ed-9d9c-cdf66ea9782e"] [:db/add "a12513cf-5b77-57ed-9d9c-cdf66ea9782e" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{\frac{\pi}{12}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} 4 \cot{\left(2 x \right)} \csc{\left(2 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u=- \csc{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Endpoint values: $\csc{\left(\frac{\pi}{6} \right)}=2,\quad \csc{\left(\frac{\pi}{2} \right)}=1$.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "a12513cf-5b77-57ed-9d9c-cdf66ea9782e" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\frac{\pi}{12}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\pi}{6}\\x=\frac{\pi}{4}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\pi}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{\frac{\pi}{12}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} 4 \cot{\left(2 x \right)} \csc{\left(2 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate and evaluate:

$$
\left[- 2 \csc{\left(u \right)}\right]_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}=\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right).
$$

The answer is

$$
2.
$$"] [:db/add "a12513cf-5b77-57ed-9d9c-cdf66ea9782e" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "a12513cf-5b77-57ed-9d9c-cdf66ea9782e" :question/answer-fields "726fbe57-9e99-5ca8-a32c-2927b6ccd612"] [:db/ensure "a12513cf-5b77-57ed-9d9c-cdf66ea9782e" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068916 :knowledge-point/questions "a12513cf-5b77-57ed-9d9c-cdf66ea9782e"] [:db/add "e9e6cfa2-30b7-57fc-bf92-13ef834aa870" :answer/id #uuid "e9e6cfa2-30b7-57fc-bf92-13ef834aa870"] [:db/add "e9e6cfa2-30b7-57fc-bf92-13ef834aa870" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "e9e6cfa2-30b7-57fc-bf92-13ef834aa870" :answer/value "\frac{3}{2}"] [:db/ensure "e9e6cfa2-30b7-57fc-bf92-13ef834aa870" :answer/validate] [:db/add "ec68e414-0ec0-5fdf-9da0-e316467f9a94" :answer-field/id #uuid "ec68e414-0ec0-5fdf-9da0-e316467f9a94"] [:db/add "ec68e414-0ec0-5fdf-9da0-e316467f9a94" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "ec68e414-0ec0-5fdf-9da0-e316467f9a94" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "ec68e414-0ec0-5fdf-9da0-e316467f9a94" :answer-field/choices "e9e6cfa2-30b7-57fc-bf92-13ef834aa870"] [:db/add "ec68e414-0ec0-5fdf-9da0-e316467f9a94" :answer-field/correct "e9e6cfa2-30b7-57fc-bf92-13ef834aa870"] [:db/ensure "ec68e414-0ec0-5fdf-9da0-e316467f9a94" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "c697346a-a2b5-5ea9-944d-83b5b405b4f7" :question/id #uuid "c697346a-a2b5-5ea9-944d-83b5b405b4f7"] [:db/add "c697346a-a2b5-5ea9-944d-83b5b405b4f7" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{\frac{\pi}{8}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} 3 \csc^{2}{\left(2 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \csc^{2}{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u=- \cot{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Endpoint values: $\cot{\left(\frac{\pi}{4} \right)}=1,\quad \cot{\left(\frac{\pi}{2} \right)}=0$.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "c697346a-a2b5-5ea9-944d-83b5b405b4f7" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\frac{\pi}{8}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\pi}{4}\\x=\frac{\pi}{4}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\pi}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{\frac{\pi}{8}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} 3 \csc^{2}{\left(2 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{2}\left(\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \csc^{2}{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate and evaluate:

$$
\left[- \frac{3 \cot{\left(u \right)}}{2}\right]_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}=\left(0\right)-\left(- \frac{3}{2}\right).
$$

The answer is

$$
\frac{3}{2}.
$$"] [:db/add "c697346a-a2b5-5ea9-944d-83b5b405b4f7" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "c697346a-a2b5-5ea9-944d-83b5b405b4f7" :question/answer-fields "ec68e414-0ec0-5fdf-9da0-e316467f9a94"] [:db/ensure "c697346a-a2b5-5ea9-944d-83b5b405b4f7" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068916 :knowledge-point/questions "c697346a-a2b5-5ea9-944d-83b5b405b4f7"] [:db/add "9e4d7c72-6826-51f9-851a-030b3f004aa9" :answer/id #uuid "9e4d7c72-6826-51f9-851a-030b3f004aa9"] [:db/add "9e4d7c72-6826-51f9-851a-030b3f004aa9" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "9e4d7c72-6826-51f9-851a-030b3f004aa9" :answer/value "\frac{3 \sec{\left(2 x \right)}}{2}"] [:db/ensure "9e4d7c72-6826-51f9-851a-030b3f004aa9" :answer/validate] [:db/add "a7af3103-1064-53cb-a423-c5073d533749" :answer-field/id #uuid "a7af3103-1064-53cb-a423-c5073d533749"] [:db/add "a7af3103-1064-53cb-a423-c5073d533749" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "a7af3103-1064-53cb-a423-c5073d533749" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "a7af3103-1064-53cb-a423-c5073d533749" :answer-field/choices "9e4d7c72-6826-51f9-851a-030b3f004aa9"] [:db/add "a7af3103-1064-53cb-a423-c5073d533749" :answer-field/correct "9e4d7c72-6826-51f9-851a-030b3f004aa9"] [:db/ensure "a7af3103-1064-53cb-a423-c5073d533749" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "399b103b-f9fc-5fcb-9095-9fb0189a1c1d" :question/id #uuid "399b103b-f9fc-5fcb-9095-9fb0189a1c1d"] [:db/add "399b103b-f9fc-5fcb-9095-9fb0189a1c1d" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "399b103b-f9fc-5fcb-9095-9fb0189a1c1d" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 3 \tan{\left(2 x \right)} \sec{\left(2 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \tan{\left(u \right)} \sec{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \tan{\left(u \right)} \sec{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{3 \sec{\left(u \right)}}{2}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{3 \sec{\left(2 x \right)}}{2}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "399b103b-f9fc-5fcb-9095-9fb0189a1c1d" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "399b103b-f9fc-5fcb-9095-9fb0189a1c1d" :question/answer-fields "a7af3103-1064-53cb-a423-c5073d533749"] [:db/ensure "399b103b-f9fc-5fcb-9095-9fb0189a1c1d" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068916 :knowledge-point/questions "399b103b-f9fc-5fcb-9095-9fb0189a1c1d"] [:db/add "56c65302-d79a-5cb1-aade-bbb618c33fbc" :answer/id #uuid "56c65302-d79a-5cb1-aade-bbb618c33fbc"] [:db/add "56c65302-d79a-5cb1-aade-bbb618c33fbc" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "56c65302-d79a-5cb1-aade-bbb618c33fbc" :answer/value "- \csc{\left(2 x + 3 \right)}"] [:db/ensure "56c65302-d79a-5cb1-aade-bbb618c33fbc" :answer/validate] [:db/add "703b45b6-fdc2-56d4-b0f7-af144b3f364c" :answer-field/id #uuid "703b45b6-fdc2-56d4-b0f7-af144b3f364c"] [:db/add "703b45b6-fdc2-56d4-b0f7-af144b3f364c" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "703b45b6-fdc2-56d4-b0f7-af144b3f364c" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "703b45b6-fdc2-56d4-b0f7-af144b3f364c" :answer-field/choices "56c65302-d79a-5cb1-aade-bbb618c33fbc"] [:db/add "703b45b6-fdc2-56d4-b0f7-af144b3f364c" :answer-field/correct "56c65302-d79a-5cb1-aade-bbb618c33fbc"] [:db/ensure "703b45b6-fdc2-56d4-b0f7-af144b3f364c" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "3c987452-833d-52ca-801c-e7c865c4a892" :question/id #uuid "3c987452-833d-52ca-801c-e7c865c4a892"] [:db/add "3c987452-833d-52ca-801c-e7c865c4a892" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "3c987452-833d-52ca-801c-e7c865c4a892" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x + 3$. Then

\int_{- \frac{\pi}{8}}^{0} 4 \sec^{2}{\left(2 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "a3775cc7-4ca1-5792-8e8e-67e74410350a" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=- \frac{\pi}{8}&\Longrightarrow u=- \frac{\pi}{4}\\x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{- \frac{\pi}{8}}^{0} 4 \sec^{2}{\left(2 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int_{- \frac{\pi}{4}}^{0} \sec^{2}{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate and evaluate:

$$
\left[2 \tan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{- \frac{\pi}{4}}^{0}=\left(0\right)-\left(-2\right).
$$

The answer is

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "262ce555-2ea1-5af2-90b8-7a5c412925cb" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=\frac{\pi}{6}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\pi}{3}\end{aligned}

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{6}} 4 \tan{\left(2 x \right)} \sec{\left(2 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}} \tan{\left(u \right)} \sec{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate and evaluate:

$$
\left[2 \sec{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}=\left(4\right)-\left(2\right).
$$

The answer is

$$
2.
$$"] [:db/add "262ce555-2ea1-5af2-90b8-7a5c412925cb" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "262ce555-2ea1-5af2-90b8-7a5c412925cb" :question/answer-fields "172894a9-0e0a-5435-b00c-654abc55aab0"] [:db/ensure "262ce555-2ea1-5af2-90b8-7a5c412925cb" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068916 :knowledge-point/questions "262ce555-2ea1-5af2-90b8-7a5c412925cb"] [:db/add "dffc9365-6a7a-5e28-b7de-12da0e7f08b1" :answer/id #uuid "dffc9365-6a7a-5e28-b7de-12da0e7f08b1"] [:db/add "dffc9365-6a7a-5e28-b7de-12da0e7f08b1" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "dffc9365-6a7a-5e28-b7de-12da0e7f08b1" :answer/value "2"] [:db/ensure "dffc9365-6a7a-5e28-b7de-12da0e7f08b1" :answer/validate] [:db/add "3a5872b9-abe8-5166-9675-198f966ed97f" :answer-field/id #uuid "3a5872b9-abe8-5166-9675-198f966ed97f"] [:db/add "3a5872b9-abe8-5166-9675-198f966ed97f" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "3a5872b9-abe8-5166-9675-198f966ed97f" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "3a5872b9-abe8-5166-9675-198f966ed97f" :answer-field/choices "dffc9365-6a7a-5e28-b7de-12da0e7f08b1"] [:db/add "3a5872b9-abe8-5166-9675-198f966ed97f" :answer-field/correct "dffc9365-6a7a-5e28-b7de-12da0e7f08b1"] [:db/ensure "3a5872b9-abe8-5166-9675-198f966ed97f" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "3b7aac27-412c-5a90-a059-92216a7c258c" :question/id #uuid "3b7aac27-412c-5a90-a059-92216a7c258c"] [:db/add "3b7aac27-412c-5a90-a059-92216a7c258c" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "3b7aac27-412c-5a90-a059-92216a7c258c" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=- 2 x + \frac{\pi}{4}$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=-2.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\pi}{4}\\x=\frac{\pi}{4}&\Longrightarrow u=- \frac{\pi}{4}\end{aligned}
$$

The new bounds decrease. Keep this order when evaluating the antiderivative.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} 2 \sec^{2}{\left(- 2 x + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=-\left(\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{- \frac{\pi}{4}} \sec^{2}{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate and evaluate:

$$
\left[- \tan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{- \frac{\pi}{4}}=\left(1\right)-\left(-1\right).
$$

The answer is

$$
2.
$$"] [:db/add "3b7aac27-412c-5a90-a059-92216a7c258c" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "3b7aac27-412c-5a90-a059-92216a7c258c" :question/answer-fields "3a5872b9-abe8-5166-9675-198f966ed97f"] [:db/ensure "3b7aac27-412c-5a90-a059-92216a7c258c" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068916 :knowledge-point/questions "3b7aac27-412c-5a90-a059-92216a7c258c"] [:db/add "b03c3251-7439-553b-ad72-28e3cbd872f0" :answer/id #uuid "b03c3251-7439-553b-ad72-28e3cbd872f0"] [:db/add "b03c3251-7439-553b-ad72-28e3cbd872f0" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "b03c3251-7439-553b-ad72-28e3cbd872f0" :answer/value "\frac{\csc{\left(3 - 4 x \right)}}{2}"] [:db/ensure "b03c3251-7439-553b-ad72-28e3cbd872f0" :answer/validate] [:db/add "7fc56e32-885c-5c5e-9954-2275c018a22f" :answer-field/id #uuid "7fc56e32-885c-5c5e-9954-2275c018a22f"] [:db/add "7fc56e32-885c-5c5e-9954-2275c018a22f" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "7fc56e32-885c-5c5e-9954-2275c018a22f" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "7fc56e32-885c-5c5e-9954-2275c018a22f" :answer-field/choices "b03c3251-7439-553b-ad72-28e3cbd872f0"] [:db/add "7fc56e32-885c-5c5e-9954-2275c018a22f" :answer-field/correct "b03c3251-7439-553b-ad72-28e3cbd872f0"] [:db/ensure "7fc56e32-885c-5c5e-9954-2275c018a22f" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "7a6b6cd2-5e3e-5af2-a25d-55ab52bf40c6" :question/id #uuid "7a6b6cd2-5e3e-5af2-a25d-55ab52bf40c6"] [:db/add "7a6b6cd2-5e3e-5af2-a25d-55ab52bf40c6" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "7a6b6cd2-5e3e-5af2-a25d-55ab52bf40c6" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3 - 4 x$. Then

\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{6}} 4 \tan{\left(2 x \right)} \sec{\left(2 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \tan{\left(u \right)} \sec{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u=\sec{\left(u \right)}+C$.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "262ce555-2ea1-5af2-90b8-7a5c412925cb" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=\frac{\pi}{6}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\pi}{3}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{6}} 4 \tan{\left(2 x \right)} \sec{\left(2 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}} \tan{\left(u \right)} \sec{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate and evaluate:

$$
\left[2 \sec{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}=\left(4\right)-\left(2\right).
$$

The answer is

$$
2.
$$"] [:db/add "262ce555-2ea1-5af2-90b8-7a5c412925cb" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "262ce555-2ea1-5af2-90b8-7a5c412925cb" :question/answer-fields "172894a9-0e0a-5435-b00c-654abc55aab0"] [:db/ensure "262ce555-2ea1-5af2-90b8-7a5c412925cb" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068916 :knowledge-point/questions "262ce555-2ea1-5af2-90b8-7a5c412925cb"] [:db/add "dffc9365-6a7a-5e28-b7de-12da0e7f08b1" :answer/id #uuid "dffc9365-6a7a-5e28-b7de-12da0e7f08b1"] [:db/add "dffc9365-6a7a-5e28-b7de-12da0e7f08b1" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "dffc9365-6a7a-5e28-b7de-12da0e7f08b1" :answer/value "2"] [:db/ensure "dffc9365-6a7a-5e28-b7de-12da0e7f08b1" :answer/validate] [:db/add "3a5872b9-abe8-5166-9675-198f966ed97f" :answer-field/id #uuid "3a5872b9-abe8-5166-9675-198f966ed97f"] [:db/add "3a5872b9-abe8-5166-9675-198f966ed97f" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "3a5872b9-abe8-5166-9675-198f966ed97f" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "3a5872b9-abe8-5166-9675-198f966ed97f" :answer-field/choices "dffc9365-6a7a-5e28-b7de-12da0e7f08b1"] [:db/add "3a5872b9-abe8-5166-9675-198f966ed97f" :answer-field/correct "dffc9365-6a7a-5e28-b7de-12da0e7f08b1"] [:db/ensure "3a5872b9-abe8-5166-9675-198f966ed97f" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "3b7aac27-412c-5a90-a059-92216a7c258c" :question/id #uuid "3b7aac27-412c-5a90-a059-92216a7c258c"] [:db/add "3b7aac27-412c-5a90-a059-92216a7c258c" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} 2 \sec^{2}{\left(- 2 x + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Endpoint values: $\tan{\left(\frac{\pi}{4} \right)}=1,\quad \tan{\left(- \frac{\pi}{4} \right)}=-1$.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "3b7aac27-412c-5a90-a059-92216a7c258c" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=- 2 x + \frac{\pi}{4}$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=-2.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\pi}{4}\\x=\frac{\pi}{4}&\Longrightarrow u=- \frac{\pi}{4}\end{aligned}
$$

The new bounds decrease. Keep this order when evaluating the antiderivative.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} 2 \sec^{2}{\left(- 2 x + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=-\left(\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{- \frac{\pi}{4}} \sec^{2}{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate and evaluate:

$$
\left[- \tan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{- \frac{\pi}{4}}=\left(1\right)-\left(-1\right).
$$

The answer is

$$
2.
$$"] [:db/add "3b7aac27-412c-5a90-a059-92216a7c258c" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "3b7aac27-412c-5a90-a059-92216a7c258c" :question/answer-fields "3a5872b9-abe8-5166-9675-198f966ed97f"] [:db/ensure "3b7aac27-412c-5a90-a059-92216a7c258c" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068916 :knowledge-point/questions "3b7aac27-412c-5a90-a059-92216a7c258c"] [:db/add "b03c3251-7439-553b-ad72-28e3cbd872f0" :answer/id #uuid "b03c3251-7439-553b-ad72-28e3cbd872f0"] [:db/add "b03c3251-7439-553b-ad72-28e3cbd872f0" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "b03c3251-7439-553b-ad72-28e3cbd872f0" :answer/value "\frac{\csc{\left(3 - 4 x \right)}}{2}"] [:db/ensure "b03c3251-7439-553b-ad72-28e3cbd872f0" :answer/validate] [:db/add "7fc56e32-885c-5c5e-9954-2275c018a22f" :answer-field/id #uuid "7fc56e32-885c-5c5e-9954-2275c018a22f"] [:db/add "7fc56e32-885c-5c5e-9954-2275c018a22f" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "7fc56e32-885c-5c5e-9954-2275c018a22f" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "7fc56e32-885c-5c5e-9954-2275c018a22f" :answer-field/choices "b03c3251-7439-553b-ad72-28e3cbd872f0"] [:db/add "7fc56e32-885c-5c5e-9954-2275c018a22f" :answer-field/correct "b03c3251-7439-553b-ad72-28e3cbd872f0"] [:db/ensure "7fc56e32-885c-5c5e-9954-2275c018a22f" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "7a6b6cd2-5e3e-5af2-a25d-55ab52bf40c6" :question/id #uuid "7a6b6cd2-5e3e-5af2-a25d-55ab52bf40c6"] [:db/add "7a6b6cd2-5e3e-5af2-a25d-55ab52bf40c6" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "7a6b6cd2-5e3e-5af2-a25d-55ab52bf40c6" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3 - 4 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=-4.

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 2 \cot{\left(3 - 4 x \right)} \csc{\left(3 - 4 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=- \frac{1}{2}\left(\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
- \frac{1}{2}\left(\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{\csc{\left(u \right)}}{2}+C.

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{\csc{\left(3 - 4 x \right)}}{2}+C.

{{answer}}"] ["a12513cf-5b77-57ed-9d9c-cdf66ea9782e" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then

Integrate and evaluate:

$$
\left[- 2 \csc{\left(u \right)}\right]_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}=\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right).
$$

The answer is

$$
2.
